subject.title: feat(clickclack): session discussions — bound channels, side agent, lifecycle sync

question: Should bundled plugins be allowed to register exact-incarnation grants that authorize selected core session tools across normal session-visibility boundaries for a side-agent integration?
rationale: The patch is intentionally fail-closed and tested, but deciding whether this is an acceptable durable plugin SDK/security boundary is product and ownership judgment rather than a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Approve the narrow grant contract
options.body: Approve the exact requester/target/incarnation-scoped model after reviewing real gateway proof, keeping the grant limited to the three stated session-tool actions.

options.title: Keep discussion channels read-only
options.body: Land only the managed-channel and pull-tool portions, deferring side-agent relay until a broader core authorization design is approved.

options.title: Move authorization behind a different core seam
options.body: Pause this implementation and design a core-owned discussion-agent capability instead of plugin-registered scoped access.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow grant contract
recommendation.body: Approve the exact requester/target/incarnation-scoped model after reviewing real gateway proof, keeping the grant limited to the three stated session-tool actions.
